title: 第23章 徐晴的暧昧勾引
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“你放屁！我老婆是出了名的贤惠！绝不可能做出这种事！你污蔑我，又污蔑我老婆，今天不收拾你，我吴长贵这个所长就白当了！”

    吴长贵眼神阴鸷，口中狠话不断，心里却惊疑不定！

    毕竟李大壮刚刚看出了他肾虚的事儿，要知道，这事儿整个清水县，就只有他和老婆俩人知道，为了保密，他之前都是去省城看病的！

    李大壮既然知道了自己的秘密，也很有可能知道自己老婆的秘密！

    “是污蔑，还是真的，你回家看看不就知道了，不过我劝你最好把你这俩手下都带去，毕竟你头上的绿帽子颜色那么浓重，可见跟你老婆搞破鞋的男人猛的很，就你这肾虚的体格子，肯定不是对手！”

    “别到时候堂堂执法所所长，却被老婆的小三给打个狗血淋头，那可就好玩了！”

    李大壮仿佛已经看到了那幅画面，笑的很灿烂！

    “所长，我忽然想起来，今天您得去县城开会，必须马上就走，要不就来不及了！”有个执法员很有眼力见，知道吴长贵其实很想回家查看，只是碍于面子不好说，于是替他编了个借口：

    “咱们可以先记下这小子的电话和住址，等忙完，再去他家抓他也不迟！”

    “行，开会重要！”吴长贵就坡下：“你们登记下这家伙的信息！”

    “好！”执法员答应着，连忙拿出手机记录。

    李大壮如实说完，又加了句：“我相信吴所长很快就会去找我，不过到时候你不但不会抓我，还会求我帮你！”

    “故弄玄虚！你给老子等着！”吴长贵咬牙撂下句狠话，带着执法员就往楼下跑！

    “哎！叔！您咋就这么走了啊！至少先把我俩的医药费先要过来啊！”吴大皮着急的喊！

    吴长贵阴沉着脸，甩下句：“你俩给老子滚远点，别跟着老子！”

    家丑不可外扬，万一老婆真跟人搞破鞋了，知道的人越少越好，尤其是老家这些亲戚！

    吴大皮和吴二皮傻眼了，连忙脚底抹油，想要开溜！

    李大壮又怎么可能让他俩跑了，一个闪身挡在门前，抱着胳膊似笑非笑的看着他们！

    “你，你想干啥？”

    “我警告你，我叔只是着急去开会，你要是敢动我们，等他回来一定会弄死你！”
content_en:
Xu Qing felt as if she was about to melt away from Li Dazhuang's strong and hot body. Her whole body was soft and weak, but she couldn't help but stretched out her lotus arms and long snow-white legs to wrap around Li Dazhuang...

    "Oh~Dazhuang~~"

    Li Dazhuang took a break from his busy schedule, raised his eyes to look at Xu Qing, who was moaning intoxicatedly, and said hoarsely: "Sister Qing, are you sure you want to give it to me?"

    "Silly boy, I've already taken the initiative to do this. If there's anything you're not sure about, just do it quickly and let me have a taste of what it's like to be a woman~~"

    Xu Qing couldn't help but press Li Dazhuang's head!

    She never knew that this taste could be so wonderful, and she simply didn’t want to be separated from Li Dazhuang for a second!

    But Li Dazhuang was still a little hesitant. If Xu Qing had done this kind of thing before, he would not have a psychological burden. But she was still a young girl. If this was given to him, would he be responsible?

    But Xu Qing couldn't help but hum and urged.

    Li Dazhuang was determined and continued to work. Whether he wanted to be responsible or not would be decided later!

    Because the two of them had just met on the first day, this kind of unfamiliar closeness was the most passionate, especially for Xu Qing. The two of them had just fought outside the field for a while, but they actually...

    Li Dazhuang was shocked. Sister Qing must be too sensitive, but women are so tempting when they act like this...

    The two of them were deeply immersed in each other, when a discordant voice came from the store downstairs: "Boss? Is anyone there? It's time to buy something!"

    Xu Qing's blurred eyes suddenly sobered up a little, and she had to get up out of reflex!

    But Li Dazhuang suppressed her: "Sister Qing, I feel uncomfortable, please don't make a sound, that person will probably leave soon."

    When Xu Qing thought about it, she felt that it was just a business, and she couldn't be as happy as doing such a thing with Li Dazhuang, so Yanbo nodded with water: "Then what are you waiting for, continue~~"

    "Hey!"

    Li Dazhuang agreed and was about to use all his strength to cultivate the uncultivated land in front of him, but suddenly he heard the people downstairs whisper: "No one has left the door open, don't you just want to give it to others for free? If you don't take it, you won't take it!"

    Then there was a rustling sound of putting fruit into the bag!

    Li Dazhuang stopped abruptly and said speechlessly: "Sister Qing, you'd better go down and take a look. That person wanted to steal your things, and he stole a lot after hearing the noise!"

    "What!?"

    Xu Qing's first reaction was that it was impossible. There were several surveillance cameras on the first floor. Who would be so bold? Stealing things under surveillance?
title_en: Chapter 24 Real men don’t lick dogs, let her lick me!
